verdict.rationale: Local conversion is a fair axis for a file converter, but Convertio does the opposite. Its docs say all conversions take place in the cloud, that it is browser-based with no software to install, and that uploaded files are deleted after conversion, so files are uploaded. There is no evidence of any on-device or offline mode, and no vendor statement that files are never uploaded.

support.subject: As a power user, conversion runs entirely on my machine, and the vendor states that files are never uploaded
